errors.text: The proposed SPS window is 900–1000 K (627–727 °C), whereas the target process requires 900–1000 °C; this unit/temperature mismatch is large enough to prevent the intended densification and phase development.

The phase-boundary statement is internally reversed: the cited evidence indicates FCC stabilization above approximately 633 K, but the hypothesis says processing must remain below the temperature where HCP becomes dominant.
No quantitative displacement, strain-rate, applied-pressure, or thermal-expansion constraint is supplied despite this being explicitly requested.
The proposed 700 K for 1000 h control is not a meaningful matched SPS control and changes both temperature and time by orders of magnitude.
The cited phase-stability evidence is largely drawn from different alloy systems and does not directly establish the asserted FCC/HCP boundary in CoCrFeNiTi.
